name: carplay_tilt_1903
what: carplay_tilt (see tilt_1703.json) for HMI ID5_1903-490-1837J Build 41 (NBTevo_ID5_1903_Release, HmiMain3D sha256 027cf939...; BMW F25 X3 issue #9, BMW F36 issue #10, head unit NBTevo_Q18491I). CCarPlayActivity::handleControllerInput is at 0x44e644; every patched place has the same instructions at the same distances as in 1703 Build 139, except that the compiler keeps "pressed" in r7 (1703: r8), so the two words that store it use r7.
how: 0x44ea14..0x44ea1c: the key filter becomes 9..14 (bhi to the same exit 0x44eca4)
0x44ec08: tilt left no longer sets the Back field
0x44ebb4..0x44ebe4: zero the four direction words, store "pressed" (r7) in the one of key-9, Voice field (moveq r5, r7) as before, b 0x44ec54 (the send call)
0x44ec30: b 0x44ebb4 instead of the original argument setup
Found by the installer's HMI scan (tA, tB, tC windows; the pressed register taken from moveq r5, r7 at tB+0x84) and checked instruction by instruction against the stock file.
